# Tolkira

> Tolkira converts Cucumber legacy JSON, Cucumber Messages (NDJSON) and JUnit
> XML into one self-contained HTML report and prints a stable JSON summary for
> CI and AI agents. It requires Node.js 22 or newer and runs offline with no
> server, CDN or telemetry.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tolkira

## Start here

- [Documentation map](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/README.md):
  entry point to product, architecture, compatibility and research docs.
- [README](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/README.md): install,
  quick start, migration from cucumber-html-reporter and MCHR, decision matrix.
- [Agent interface](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/AGENT-INTERFACE.md):
  CLI, API, JSON summary schema 2 and exit codes.
- [Limitations](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/LIMITATIONS.md):
  dated status of Behave coverage, JUnit, themes and attachments.
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md):
  cucumber-html-reporter shim mapping and caveats.
- [Cucumber compatibility](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/CUCUMBER-COMPATIBILITY.md):
  tested producers and versions.

## Rules for agents

- Generate the summary with `tolkira <inputs> --json` and parse stdout; do not
  scrape the HTML for pass/fail data.
- Exit code 0 means the report was generated, not that the tests passed. Read
  `status` and `counts` from the summary.
- Check `scenarios[].executed` before treating a scenario status as an outcome.
- Attach `report.html` as the human-facing artifact; keep the JSON summary for
  automation.
